title: The Live Debt
author: Ulyana Quintana
blurb: Sebastian Winterbourne, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
